title: Context7 in the workflow
html:
Context7 in the workflow

During tutorial 03, when the AI was writing the slot-confirmation integration with the payment gateway, it needed the gateway's CURRENT API — not the API from when its model was trained. That gap is what the Context7 integration exists for.

The trigger

The operation rule lives at profile/context7.md in the config (the shelf of profile): BEFORE answering about a library/framework/SDK/API/CLI/cloud, the agent consults Context7 — it resolves the library ID and fetches the current documentation through the MCP tool. Model memory ages; the source's documentation doesn't.

How the kit delivers it

The golmet install wizard registers the Context7 MCP tool in the engine (the catalog marks the integration), and the guided setup (gm-setup, optional) validates it with a smoke test. The API key is optional (free at context7.com) — via the instance's profile/, never in the repo.

The boundary

Context7 is public documentation research — product data (the org, tokens, requirements) never goes into the query. In MeuApp, the AI looked up how the gateway confirms payments; HOW MeuApp confirms the slot is in RN-001 — one is the world's API, the other is your product's rule.
